name: Marry Me, Misato!
source: You are the hero, whose only love is Misato decides to marry her. But it's obvious - she is an anime character, how can you marry her then? However, your love is so strong... And you have a plan...
translation: 你是故事主人公，唯一爱着的人是美里，并决定与她结婚。可问题显而易见——她是动画角色，你要怎样和她结婚？然而，你的爱如此强烈…而且，你已经想好了一个计划…
